item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission examined misconduct risks in WA prisons through its joint investigation with the Department of Justice.
item.section: Scope and purpose of this report
item.support: The joint investigation into corruption within WA prisons has focused on contraband entering prisons and inappropriate associations between prison staff and prisoners.

item.text: The report brought together lessons from that investigation, other misconduct agencies and Auditor General reports.
item.support: This report brings together lessons from those reports and from misconduct agencies across Australia

item.text: The Commission found deficiencies in the department's identification and management of serious misconduct risks.
item.support: The Commission has identified a number of areas where DoJ's identification and management of serious misconduct risk is inadequate.

item.text: Its twenty recommendations covered corruption prevention, investigations, information sharing, screening, drug testing and monitoring the effectiveness of controls.
item.support: introduce a system to track and measure the effectiveness of serious misconduct strategies

item.text: The Commission planned to review implementation after a year.
item.support: It will report on the implementation of those recommendations in one year.
